name: code-doc-assistant
description: Conversational assistant that ingests a codebase and answers grounded questions about it.

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=@app/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@app/shared && npm run build --workspace=@app/api && npm run build --workspace=@app/web && npm run build --workspace=@app/mcp
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@app/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=@app/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.mcp:build: npm run build --workspace=@app/shared && npm run build --workspace=@app/mcp
scripts.docker:clean: docker image prune -f && docker builder prune -f --filter unused-for=168h
